This screenshot shows a **case study or project portfolio page for Celsius** (an HVAC/air conditioning company). The page displays three client projects with detailed information.

## **Yes, BTU ranges and room area (sq ft) details are clearly visible:**

**Case 01 - Eyepax IT Consulting (Commercial):**
- **Area:** 2,100 sq ft
- **Units:** 3 × 48,000 BTU Cassette type air conditioning units

**Case 02 - Emperor Residencies (Residential):**
- **Area:** 600 sq ft apartment
- **Units:** 
  - 1 × 24,000 BTU unit (Living room)
  - 2 × 12,000 BTU units (Bedrooms)

## **Sections shown in the screenshot:**

1. **Header/Navigation**: Services, Solutions, Brands menu + "BOOK DEMO" button

2. **Three Project Cards** (each containing):
   - **Left panel (dark blue)**:
     - Category tag (Commercial/Residential/Service)
     - Case number
     - Client name
     - Location
     - Square footage
     - Project type description
     - "UNITS / WORK" section with specific BTU specifications
   
   - **Right panel (light gray)**:
     - "PROJECT OVERVIEW" heading
     - Detailed project narrative/description
     - Client testimonial with quotation marks

3. **Visible Projects:**
   - **Eyepax IT Consulting** - Commercial transformation project
   - **Emperor Residencies** - Residential comfort enhancement  
   - **Gas Leak Breakdown** - Service/maintenance call (partially visible at bottom)

The layout uses a split-card design with technical specs on the left and storytelling/testimonials on the right.
